noAcceptanceClaim: Synthetic execution record. It shows how the candidate control code decided on synthetic inputs; it grants no egress, approves no publication and is not the accept-phase evidence index.
noSensitiveExecution: No real research ran. Every topic, approval, response, credential, e-mail address and path is a labelled synthetic fixture defined in scripts/team/R-06/egress_controls.py; the transport is an in-process fake and no network destination was contacted.

checksRun.check: inspection: R-06 output fields vs M1-05 central schema
checksRun.result: every case produced an M1-05 public_candidate and public_manifest verified by record_pipeline.verify with approval pending; publication approval records are validated against $defs.approval read from the schema file; schema, pipeline and profile digests are checked before any case

checksRun.check: mutation controls (in-memory source replacement; file on disk unchanged)

mutations.mutation: unlisted destination falls back to the first profile destination
source domain check weakened to substring match
publication approval not compared with this manifest digest

observations.subject: M1-05 suspected-sensitive pattern
observations.observed: a clean output event containing an https URL is removed as suspected_sensitive by record_pipeline (the drive-letter branch of its pattern matches the 's:/' in 'https://')
observations.effect: over-redaction only; the public candidate already omits free text, so no leak. Reported to the #21 owner; #21 files are not modified here.

failedAttempts.observed: the destination-fallback mutation made an unscripted send and FakeTransport raised IndexError, stopping the whole run
failedAttempts.handling: FakeTransport now counts an unscripted send and returns an empty body that the sanitiser refuses, so the mutation shows as a case mismatch; tests and cases rerun after the change

blockers.subject: search destination
blockers.detail: ADR 0004 names a search capability, but the profile egress.destinations has no search destination or approval owner, so every search request is refused (R06-N09). A PM decision to add the destination, its data-class ceiling and approval owner is needed before a search egress can be allowed.

blockers.subject: harness actor role
blockers.detail: the profile has no research-harness role; the cases use role:authoring-agent with DEST-MODEL-AUTHOR. Whether the research harness is its own actor (ADR 0004 decision 1) is a PM decision.

blockers.subject: harness wiring
blockers.detail: tools/research/research.py is not wired to these controls; wiring is outside this work order's write scope.

blockers.subject: accept evidence index
blockers.detail: docs/evidence/R-06/executed-egress-output-verification-index.json is an accept-phase output and is not written by this candidate.

limits: Decisions come from candidate code with an in-process fake transport; proxy, raw-socket or subprocess network bypass is not tested (OS or firewall enforcement belongs to M1-03).
Sanitiser patterns are a candidate ruleset, not a complete sensitive-data detector.
Approval records are synthetic and unauthenticated.
The accept-phase profile and M1-02 policy record are not bound yet.
No independent review has been performed.
